title: --rover red on 2f535486 was the suite, not the rover: site guards wore the parked hull down until the sector was LOST, and two pages raced the moving rover
context: --rover went red on 2f535486 in a different place almost every run: the escorted hunted page (idle at home, no order), the wall page (a new road round the shut cell: no reroute within 10 s), NO ROAD (no road: held never came) and the escorted hunted trip home (the rover disabled, nobody to restart it). No rover file (src/fx/rover-glue.js, src/domain/rover-run.js, src/content/rover.js, drive-ground, rover-road, hull-flare) and no hull-damage rule changed since c8c4be48, where it passed. The merges since (colony-grid, small-items, flow-fixes) moved the base's cells, the roads and the trips' timing, and flow-fixes' 29d02b01 widened the harness cull to bodies with no breach source; all of these move where the richest ground and the parked hull end up.
outcome: A suite bug, not a game bug. Fixes in scripts/browser-test.mjs, assertions unchanged. (1) THE SECTOR LOST UNDER THE RUN: the suite parks the hull on the open cell nearest the richest ground for the first trip, the unescorted restart and the escort. That cell can lie inside an expedition site, whose guards (STORY_EXPEDITIONS, src/fx/expedition-glue.js) stay put and are spared both by sectorCull and by the rover's threat count. They dented the hull: a probe caught a guard small Reed on the hull's own cell (17175) when it was lost. Losses showed at the first trip (3 to 2 hulls), the unescorted restart (2 to 1, or 1/4 dents carried on) and the escort. The last hull's loss is loseGame, the sector LOST (phase lost-shown), and breakHome resets the rover: idle, flares cleared, order null, the 'idle at home, no order' dump (break event at 442.2 s, lastBreak set). Now every site's guards are killed once after the ground is cleared (killGuards over STORY_EXPEDITIONS.sites, as the corridor probe does), and each hunted page mends the hull under the gantry first, after waiting out a lost hull's wreck, dash and deploy. A loss refills the dents at once and moves the hull to its berth (cell 7860) seconds later, over any placeTank, so the state now reads hullDown (src/td-tab.js state(), on the existing hulls line: no line added). (2) THE WALL PAGE read the rover's state, asked each of 17 cells' ring in its own evaluate, then shut the widest, picked from k+3. At ROVER.speed 16 m/s on ~9.5 m cells the rover drove on 2-5 cells over those round trips, so the shut cell was often behind it. Now one evaluate reads, picks from k+5 (past the 16 m it can cover before its 1 s ROVER.recheck) and shuts. (3) NO ROAD shut the ring round the cell the rover stood on when read. The recheck came up to 1 s later with the rover a cell on, outside that ring, and it rerouted (HEAD run: read at k 19, cell 22004). Now one evaluate shuts every open cell round the cell it stands on and the next three of its road. The per-page prints carry the hull's cell, hulls, dents and the sector's phase; the hunted failures print the sector phase and the hull.
alternatives: Game changes: guards that cannot reach a parked hull, or a road check the moment a cell closes. Rejected: guards denting a hull parked in their site, and the 1 s look at the road, are the rules as designed; the suite stood the hull there and raced the rover.

Bisecting the three merges: not done. Probes showed the mechanism directly (the guard on the hull's cell, the break event, the rover past the shut cell); the merges only changed which run lost which race.
A test hand to mend the hull or add hulls (the board's mendHull/addHull are not on __stalheartTest): not added; the game's own repair spot does it.
evidence: HEAD 2f535486 unmodified: --rover failed at NO ROAD (read at k 19, cell 22004; rerouted, never stuck)

Race fixes, then a dents-only mend (before the guards): 5 of 8 runs green; the rest red at the escorted hunted page: once the trip home (hull at 7860, not the flare's 9616), twice the rover at the hunted ground with sector lost-shown and a break event at 442.2 s

Hull probe (temporary, removed): F at 17175 with 3 hulls; by ROVER TRIP 2 hulls, the hull at 7860; at the loss a guard Reed (small) on cell 17175, d 0, and a guard amoeba 3.6 cells off. A second probe run: the escort hull mended whole, placed at 17175, lost, at 7860 with 1 hull left

All fixes: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --rover green three runs in a row, 8/8 pages each, 3 hulls and 4/4 dents at every page; REROUTE round cells 1073, 37038, 1073 (35-43 cells); NO ROAD held at 0.00 m in 3 s on islands of four with 7-9 cells shut
npm test: 350 test programs passed; npm run check green; node --check scripts/browser-test.mjs src/td-tab.js
